name: Luma Forma Platform Sneaker
description: A chunky platform sneaker with a 4cm EVA midsole in translucent milky white and a smooth synth-leather upper in pastel or neutral tones. Luma Forma is a fashion brand that sits at the upper edge of accessible luxury — these sneakers are the kind you wear to a rooftop party, a gallery, or a casual dinner where you still want to look deliberate. The platform reads as confident without reading as formal.
what_it_says: You're social, fashion-aware, and you understand the difference between dressed up and dressed down.
story_hooks: A specific pastel colorway became associated with a youth movement after a high-profile protest — wearing it now carries an unintended political signal.
Luma Forma's lead designer recently defected to a street brand — the last official collection is already being called a classic.
